title: Glenmark Pharma hits a record high

timeline.title: Glenmark Pharma hits a record high
timeline.line: Glenmark rose to an all-time high of ₹2,755.45, extending a four-day winning run
more: It had hit a previous peak of ₹2,730 on Wednesday
No company-specific trigger was reported; reports cite technical momentum

src.title: Broad-Based Technical Strength Lifts Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Ltd. to 52-Week High of Rs 2755.45
